name: TeamStarWolf - The Ransomware Ecosystem, 2019 to 2026 (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK for ICS techniques for ransomware on IT networks that stopped operations: Colonial Pipeline's precautionary shutdown (May 2021) and the water and wastewater incidents in CISA AA21-287A. Scores: 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id.

techniques.comment: Colonial Pipeline halted pipeline operations as a precaution after ransomware on its IT network, 7 May 2021 (basis: Behavior). Sources [71][62] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/RANSOMWARE_ECOSYSTEM.md.
Ransomware encrypted SCADA servers at California (Aug 2021) and Nevada (Mar 2021) water systems (basis: Behavior). Sources [3] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/RANSOMWARE_ECOSYSTEM.md.
ZuCaNo reached a Maine wastewater SCADA computer through remote access (Jul 2021) (basis: Behavior). Sources [3] refer to the Sources table of case-studies/RANSOMWARE_ECOSYSTEM.md.

legendItems.label: 70: behavior described by the source, id assigned by the study
100: the opened source prints the ATT&CK id
